descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Play mini-golf using natural hand tracking, fully playable from your seat.

Line up your shot, pull back, and release with intuitive hand gestures. Pocket Putt brings compact mini-golf courses into mixed reality, designed for smooth play, quick retries, and satisfying precision.

Play official courses, discover community-made holes, unlock new balls, and keep improving your best runs.

# -

# Official Courses & Challenges

[media]
Play handcrafted courses built around clean putting, obstacles, shortcuts, and replayable score-chasing. Compete on leaderboards, unlock achievements, and return for seasonal and weekly challenges.

# -

# Natural Hand Tracking

[media]
Aim, pinch, pull, and release your shots with your hands. Use subtle thumb gestures to rotate around the ball, return to the menu, or reposition without interrupting play.

# -

# Create & Share Holes

[media]
Build your own mini-golf holes, publish them, and let other players try your creations. Explore community-made layouts for fresh challenges beyond the official courses.

# -

# Your Space, Your Course

[media]
Place mini-golf lanes on your floor or table and play seated or standing. Pocket Putt turns everyday spaces into compact mixed reality courses.

# -

Line up your shot and play mini-golf right where you are.
